findings.description: The MALM product page has more than one button labelled "Add to cart"; the first one in DOM order adds the ÅKREHAMN mattress ($499) instead of the bed frame, with no confirmation naming the item added.
findings.proposed_fix: Give each add button an aria-label that names the product ("Add MALM bed frame to cart" / "Add ÅKREHAMN mattress to cart") and show a confirmation toast that names the item added.

findings.description: A valid but unserved Canadian postal code (X0A 0H0) is accepted silently: the delivery step shows "Information currently unavailable" with no error, no explanation and no delivery option, so the shopper cannot proceed. The same shopper from GB with a served code reaches the delivery options.
findings.proposed_fix: When no delivery service covers the postal code, render an explicit role="alert" message ("Home delivery is not available for X0A 0H0") next to the input and surface the Click & collect / pick-up-point alternative as the primary action.

findings.description: "Continue to checkout" does not navigate; it injects a "Choose how you'd like to checkout" login panel at the same URL, and on a phone the "Continue as guest" link sits below the fold under the loyalty pitch.
findings.proposed_fix: Route Continue to checkout to /ca/en/order/delivery/ with a URL change, or render the guest option as a visible button above the loyalty benefits with role="dialog" and focus moved to it.
